# Dimitrios Kotlidas

> Performance Marketing Specialist scaling paid campaigns profitably across Meta Ads and Google Ads. €500K+ managed, up to 11.93x ROAS. Based in Strasbourg, France, working remote-first with brands across Europe.

Dimitrios Kotlidas helps e-commerce and lead-gen brands turn ad spend into predictable, scalable growth. Services include Meta Ads, Google Ads, tracking and attribution setup (server-side GTM), and consulting. Minimum engagement budget: €1,500/month in ad spend.
